g.text: SD10 — Take an Item with an Inventory Button (UC05, F05; Command, Composite)
(n1) proposal = new ActionProposal(TAKE, "iron key", null); buttons skip the LLM (no interpret(), no narrate())
(n2) Composite: a Container adds its own weight to getWeight() of everything inside it, at any depth; a leaf (Weapon, Consumable, KeyItem) returns its own weight
(n3) invalid if the item is not in the location or too heavy ("You carry 9.5 of 10 kg.")
(n4) ownerId = null here; if the item belongs to an NPC who is not handing it over in a conversation, the ITEM event records a theft (alignment delta −2)
(n5) text = the results' messages (getMessage()), so a button turn needs no LLM
SD03 — mode check: allows(TAKE) is false in combat
SD03 — the ITEM event is published (SD05):
quests advance and the inventory panel refreshes
